author: Solenia Suarez
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---


```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "red",
    name = "Median household income",
    labels = scales::label_dollar()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by County",
    subtitle = "Texas, 2020",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
